name: Materials Live Wallpaper
tagline: A live wallpaper that renders materials
blurb: Materials Live Wallpaper renders different materials that reflect light based on device rotation.
description:
Materials Live Wallpaper renders different materials that reflect light based on device rotation.
The materials can be any level of matte, shiny and brushed and can have different textures.
